claims.text: The resort is located on the banks of the Mae Ping River.

findings.quote: Located on the banks of the Mae Ping River, Anantara Chiang Mai Resort opens doors to a world of discovery.

claims.text: The resort is a short tuk tuk ride from Chiang Mai's Old Town and is hidden behind a bamboo wall.

findings.quote: It’s just a short tuk tuk ride from Chiang Mai’s Old Town to this gorgeous urban resort.
Old Town to this gorgeous urban resort that’s hidden behind a bamboo wall.

claims.text: The resort centres on the 1921 House, the former British consulate, built over a century ago.

findings.quote: the magnificent 1921 House, formerly the British consulate and built over a century ago.

claims.text: All accommodations have large terraces furnished with daybeds.

findings.quote: all accommodations have super-sized terraces furnished with cushy daybeds

claims.text: Deluxe rooms have a balcony or terrace overlooking the garden or river.

findings.quote: Deluxe rooms are spacious with sleek, contemporary design bathed in natural sunlight.
Balcony or terrace overlooking garden or river

claims.text: Serviced suites, suited to long stays and families, are across the road, linked by a walkway, with full use of the resort's services and facilities.

findings.quote: Serviced suites are ideal for long-term stays and families. Located across the road and linked by a walkway, guests enjoy all the services and facilities of the resort.

claims.text: Serviced suites have a kitchen, laundry, and dining, living and work spaces.

findings.quote: Kitchen, laundry, dining, living and work spaces

claims.text: Anantara Spa offers daily wellness activities, traditional Thai healing and IV drips.

findings.quote: with daily wellness activities, traditional Thai healing and IV drips at Anantara Spa

claims.text: The spa offers a mix of Lanna-inspired rituals and Western treatments.

findings.quote: the spa, which offers a mix of Lanna-inspired rituals and Western treatments

claims.text: The resort offers muay Thai and Spice Spoons cooking classes.

findings.quote: immersions in the local culture with muay Thai and Spice Spoons cooking classes.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served each day on the verandah of the 1921 House.

findings.quote: the magnificent 1921 House, formerly the British consulate and built over a century ago. Here, afternoon tea is served on the verandah each day

claims.text: Several of the city's markets are nearby, including the Saturday and Sunday Markets and the Chiang Mai Night Bazaar.

findings.quote: Also nearby are several of the bustling markets that the city is known for, from the Saturday and Sunday Markets to the Chiang Mai Night Bazaar.

claims.text: Daily river cruises depart from the resort's private pier.

findings.quote: Daily river cruises departing from the resort’s private pier

claims.text: The infinity pool is surrounded by lily ponds and loungers and overlooks the river.

findings.quote: the 112-foot infinity pool, which is surrounded by lily ponds and loungers, and overlooks the river.

claims.text: Pool Suites have a private plunge pool and a cabana, with privileges that include in-suite check-in and a floating breakfast.

findings.quote: Our most exclusive suite is luxurious in every way, with a private plunge pool and breezy cabana to enjoy, and privileges that include an in-suite check-in and floating breakfast.

claims.text: The complex was designed by the late Australian architect Kerry Hill.

findings.quote: The complex was designed by the late Australian architect Kerry Hill

claims.text: A Street Wise Guru can lead insider tours of lesser-known markets and temples, traditional coffee houses and street food stalls.

findings.quote: a dedicated Street Wise Guru can lead you on insider tours of lesser-known markets and temples, traditional coffee houses, street food stalls, and more.

claims.text: There is no Kids Club, but activities are offered for children.

findings.quote: We do not have a Kids Club but we do offer activities available for children.

claims.text: There are no connecting rooms, but guests may request adjoining rooms.

findings.quote: We do not have connecting rooms but guests may request adjoining rooms.
